problem_type: Manual host media and prompt composition capabilities
symptom: Generated inline preview bytes cannot persist and manual preset reads try an unavailable native skill runtime
direct_cause: Inline import RPC was omitted and builtin prompt composition always included native skill catalog
class_root: Manual host must expose its owned byte import and compose only available optional prompt producers
affected_population: Inline media migration and generated thumbnails
internal_only_reason: The Nomi surface authority is a domain authorization object; jobs have separate persistent ownership
invariants: Only committed project-owned or inline media can enter the web byte import
Manual prompt hosts do not instantiate unsupported skill catalogs
Desktop default prompt composition remains unchanged

door_reduction.why_not: Web host, builtin composition owner and library cache owner are separate existing roles

generality_proof: The original asset owner processes inline and canonical URLs after project authorization; one builtin composition option controls native catalog inclusion across every host call

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Authorize manual byte import and select supported prompt producers

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual inline write, foreign project and network URL tests
Composition option propagates through cache/library owner

recurrence.reason: Every hydrated inline image and preset read can repeat the omitted capability
same_class_scan: door-map getBuiltinPrompts and withBuiltinPrompts: existing pack and library owners
door-map getPromptLibrary: IPC caller; inspected web caller and native skill loader
projectMediaMigration data URL import and projectAssetStore canonical/data URL paths inspected

prevention.invariant: Manual capability selection stays at host and shared composition boundaries
prevention.failure_mode: Foreign project or network URL import rejects; unsupported skill producer is not instantiated
prevention.strategy: Use existing asset import with authority and explicit optional producer composition

legacy_paths.rationale: New web transport keeps the existing runtime contract; there is no alternate legacy collector

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application owns source windows and generation completion policy

migration: Server canonical media and desktop defaults remain valid; no existing data is rewritten
residual_risks: Deployed preset and inline preview persistence need browser verification

invariant_owner_layer.why: Host boundary chooses authorized media and available prompt sources
